Boundaries:
- CityChat DS Add-on v0.8 is approved normative authoring guidance; Product Experience Profile v0.4 and Product Brief v8 remain draft dependencies.
- Frontstage identity and the public asset library are CityChat-only. Other product profiles in the immutable LDS vendor snapshot are not CityChat assets or rendering authority.
- CityScan has exactly three prompts: แถวนี้น่าอยู่ยังไง; น่าเที่ยวตรงไหน; น่าค้าขายอะไรดี. Their CityCells remain separate and may not be collapsed into one aggregate CityScore.
- The case library contains three constructive local fixtures, each with scan/citizen/officer lenses, and one rejected aggregate-score case.
- The v0.8.0 control, icon, motion, colour, taxonomy, and case records bind this team-learning artifact only; specimens do not enable product capabilities.
- All example places, values, responses, handoffs, checklists, owners, and statuses are local conceptual fixtures rather than live data or runtime evidence.
- LINE, persistence, receipts, sharing, cross-surface runtime handoff, officer operations, and telemetry are not enabled in this artifact.
- Open sources and verify important claims before promoting anything into a governed product object.
